comments: No 2D/3D control correspondence is assumed, inferred or invented in this template.
Acquire the actual scanned image, independently measure camera intrinsics or document calibration, then identify at least six distinct non-coplanar model points visible in the image.
A photograph taken from a different era or depicting a prebuild mockup must not calibrate a built 1939 facade without phase review.
Do not solve if historical photo features lack correspondence to a genuinely matching modeled 3D surface. The existing models are provisional.
